summary: Red Robin Gourmet Burgers via its subsidiary RRI entered an Asset Purchase Agreement to sell 30 company-owned restaurants in Washington and Idaho to Evergreen Dining LLC for $23.5 million cash, subject to adjustments. The transaction includes customary due diligence, landlord/liquor/lender consents, with closing targeted by August 21, 2026, outside date October 2, 2026. Post-closing, Evergreen will operate as franchised locations. No board recommendation or advisors named. Net proceeds will reduce debt. Watch for regulatory and landlord consent timing; risk-arb centers on franchise conversion execution and re-franchising strategy.
